modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On December 24, 1979: The first Ariane 1 rocket is launched from ELA-1 at the Guiana Space Centre.
On December 24, 1906: Reginald Fessenden transmits the first radio broadcast; consisting of a poetry reading, a violin solo, and a speech.
On December 24, 1818: The first performance of "Silent Night" takes place in the Nikolauskirche in Oberndorf, Austria.
On December 24, 1777: Kiritimati, also called Christmas Island, is discovered by James Cook.
On December 24, 1952: First flight of Britain's Handley Page Victor strategic bomber.
